race.comment: DOUBLE SAID (6) kicked off the campaign with back-to-back placings before delivering in style at his latest appearance here, scoring comfortably by 14 metres after taking control of the race a fair way from home. Draws wider and is up in grade but should be at his peak now so could can go on with the job. There was plenty to like about the latest performance of HEEZ REASONABLE (2) when he came from the back row and finished third here on Monday. Should have no excuses from this advantageous draw. PIXIEBELLE (3) draws much better than last start and had placed in two of her previous three outings here. SYLVIA KAY NZ (4) must be respected after leading to score by 2.6 metres at this venue on Monday.
